entities.name: Query Nnr protein
observations: 519 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular mass 54.96 kDa and pI 5.38.
Contains YjeF_N domain (PF03853) at residues 39–204 and Carb_kinase domain (PF01256) at residues 263–501.
Sequence matches reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes at 31.6–33.4% identity with 91.7–94.8% query coverage.

entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: Bifunctional enzyme that epimerizes S- and R-NAD(P)HX and dehydrates S-NAD(P)HX using ADP, producing AMP and phosphate while regenerating NAD(P)H.
Annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and EC 4.2.1.136 for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity.
Reviewed homologs bind one potassium ion per subunit; pathway context is metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: This interconverts the two epimers of hydrated NADH or NADPH without changing the nucleotide oxidation state.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: The reaction repairs hydrated NAD(P)H by restoring the native reduced dinucleotide and consuming ADP.
